GRIEVANCE XXIV ◆ LIBERTY AND DUE PROCESS

He has filled the streets with masked federal agents whose force has fallen upon protesters, observers, and bystanders.

THE RECORD SHOWS

Immigration enforcement expanded into militarized domestic operations, with documented detentions of observers and U.S. citizens.

PBS and ProPublica documented the spread of immigration arrests into public protests and other encounters. Reuters described the detention of people who followed immigration agents to observe their operations. Federal officials maintain that agents face threats and must be able to enforce the law safely.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. 2025–26The administration expanded immigration operations with large deployments of armed and frequently masked federal personnel.
  2. January 2026Deadly encounters in Minnesota drew challenges to early federal explanations and demands for independent investigation.
  3. April 2026FRONTLINE and ProPublica investigated arrests of protesters, legal observers, and bystanders; many cases did not withstand scrutiny.
